entities.summary: Amira Mohamed Ali is a German politician who served as a member of the Bundestag from 2017 to 2025 and has been one of the federal co-chairs of the BSW since 2024. From 12 November 2019 till October 2023, she was the parliamentary co-chairperson of The Left alongside Dietmar Bartsch.
